scope: Share high-mask block and digit proofs in a dedicated helper module
validation: The new module and three changed consumers pass; all 13 tracked module-directory direct clients pass paired builds and all paired client objects match. Three individual two-object-pinned global simp/instance and option censuses are unchanged. The combined interface probe has 251 matching common reports, including all named user-facing theorem reports, with 144 removed names, 57 added and 14 changed common generated reports. Source/current-object producer receipts match 35 of 36 external project pairs.
limitations: The helper adds public declarations and replaces three existing ListGetDCases imports with a new module. The environment loses 141 public generated proof auxiliaries and three private block names, and 14 other generated public type/axiom reports change. Exact and short-pattern tracked Lean/Python searches found no references; arbitrary external or dynamic references remain untested.

The umbrella is the only untested tracked direct importer; ZFCAxioms and the wider downstream/project/Foundation/Mathlib transitive closure are untested or cached. NativeCyclicCarry lacks a matching source/object producer in the documented search; several prior producer receipts have only a single source sample.

All raw compressed environment logs from selected and nonselected alternatives are omitted for compactness; their external paths, byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes are retained in bundle/omitted-logs.json, together with all comparison/diff JSON and probe records. Independent full replay of those recorded logs requires the external originals. The full-sharing alternative would expose five new simp registrations to owner and two tested importer environments.

The discarded full-alternative duplicate-overlay setup error had no raw command-output log saved; its failure is disclosed in bundle/failure-gap.txt. The distinct timeout and parser failure sources, logs, times and records are retained.

The local 2,000,000-heartbeat setting is scoped to the new proof; importing probes show default internal heartbeat budget unchanged. Shared-load timings are single samples and not general benchmarks. Author records predate commit; independent audit verifies parent/commit. Compiled objects and cached overlays are omitted and temporary /dev/shm objects are required for external byte verification.
